title.narrative: Partner Identification – Åbenkirke Herning B&U and OpenChurch Uganda Youth

description.narrative: OpenChurch Herning Youth (OCH Youth) aims at identifying and developing a strong partnership withOpenChurch Uganda (OCU). OCU exists to ensure that people make a positive impact in their community and tobe a voice to the young generation. This organization has been carefully selected as they share our passion todevelop young leaders through capacity building. With this project we aim to lay a foundation for a futurecollaboration to create a reliable and structured youth work in OCU. We already see a natural partnershipbetween the church organizations as the leadership of OCH has a formal partnership with OCU. Therefore, we seethe importance of establishing a collaboration between OCH's youth group and the youth group in OCU. Thisproject is about meeting our potential partners to see their facilities, meet their key people, talk about values,and gain a better understanding of the structure in their organization.
